Hero Title: Cold Storage That Keeps Up With Your Kitchen — Every Hour of Every Day.
Hero Subtitle: Commercial Refrigeration Equipment for UAE Restaurants, Hotels & Food Facilities
Feature 1 Description: Steelcraft supplies the full spectrum of commercial refrigeration — from standalone upright chillers and undercounter units to reach-in freezers, blast chillers, shock freezers, and custom-built walk-in cold rooms. For front-of-house display, we provide pastry display refrigerators, fish and seafood display counters, meat display cases, and beverage display fridges that combine temperature precision with visual appeal. Ice equipment covers cube makers, flake ice machines, and nugget ice makers — matched to the volume requirements of bars, medical facilities, fishmongers, and hotel room service operations. Every unit is specified for UAE ambient temperatures, ensuring reliable performance in kitchens and back-of-house areas where ambient conditions regularly exceed 30°C.
Feature 2 Description: For kitchens operating cook-chill or cook-freeze systems — including hotel banqueting operations, central production kitchens, and high-volume catering facilities — blast chillers and shock freezers are essential food safety tools, not optional extras. A blast chiller brings cooked food from +70°C to +3°C in under 90 minutes, arresting bacterial growth and extending safe shelf life. A shock freezer reaches -18°C at the food's core within the time frames required by food safety regulation. Steelcraft specifies blast chilling and shock freezing equipment based on your batch sizes and production cycles, and advises on the critical integration of this equipment into your HACCP food safety management system. Staff training on correct operating procedures is included.
Feature 3 Description: Front-of-house display refrigeration demands a balance between consistent internal temperature and attractive visual presentation. Steelcraft sources curved-glass and flat-glass display counters suited to pastry shops, hotel lobbies, buffet-format restaurants, and fishmongers. Custom walk-in cold rooms and freezer rooms are designed and built to your exact internal dimensions and temperature requirements — including specialist rooms for wine, cheese, and fresh fish. All cold room builds include insulated panel supply, door and door-hardware installation, refrigeration plant specification, and commissioning by a certified refrigeration engineer. Monitoring systems with remote temperature alerting are available as an add-on, helping operators meet food authority audit requirements.
Feature 4 Description: Front-of-house display refrigeration demands a balance between consistent internal temperature and attractive visual presentation. Steelcraft sources curved-glass and flat-glass display counters suited to pastry shops, hotel lobbies, buffet-format restaurants, and fishmongers. Our Process Title: Specifying Commercial Refrigeration for UAE Conditions
Our Process Description: Refrigeration equipment in the UAE faces a challenge that European-rated equipment is not always designed for: sustained high ambient temperatures in back-of-house areas, with external temperatures regularly reaching 45°C in summer. Steelcraft specifies equipment with tropical ratings (SN-T or T-class) where required, and advises on condenser placement and ventilation to prevent premature compressor failure — a common and costly problem when equipment is installed in poorly ventilated plant rooms. We provide a full refrigeration schedule as part of the kitchen design package, showing each unit, its internal temperature band, its utility connections, and its daily energy consumption. This enables MEP engineers to size electrical supply correctly and operators to benchmark their running costs.
CTA 1 Description: We specify refrigeration equipment rated for UAE ambient temperatures — preventing the premature failures that occur when standard European-rated units operate in Gulf conditions.
CTA 2 Description: From undercounter chillers to blast freezers and walk-in cold rooms — Steelcraft covers every refrigeration need in your kitchen from a single point of contact.

Feature 1 Title: The Right Dishwasher for Your Operation
Feature 1 Description: Choosing the wrong dishwasher is one of the most operationally damaging decisions a commercial kitchen can make. Too small, and dirty ware queues during peak service. Too large, and water, chemical, and energy costs spiral unnecessarily. Steelcraft's dishwashing equipment range covers every scale of operation: undercounter glasswashers for bars and cafés; pass-through hood-type machines for mid-sized restaurants and hotels; and fully automatic rack conveyor systems for high-volume hotel banqueting operations, institutional catering, and central production kitchens. We specify by basket capacity, cycle time, and peak throughput requirement — not by price point — to ensure the machine you receive is the machine your kitchen actually needs.
Feature 2 Description: Steelcraft supplies commercial warewashing equipment from manufacturers with established service networks and genuine spare parts availability in the UAE — including Meiko, Hobart, Comenda, Electrolux, and DIHR. Each brand brings specific strengths: Meiko is known for energy and water recovery technology; Hobart for durability in the most demanding institutional environments; Comenda for compact high-output machines suited to Italian-style fast-service restaurants; DIHR for robust value in mid-market applications. We help clients understand these distinctions and select accordingly. All machines are supplied with dosing pump connections for detergent and rinse aid, and our team coordinates chemical supply partnerships with established warewashing chemical providers where required.
Feature 3 Title: Pot Washers, Tray Washers & Flight Systems
Feature 3 Description: Beyond crockery and glassware, Steelcraft supplies specialist warewashing solutions for pots, pans, and gastronorm containers — including standalone pot washing sinks with spray arms and pressurised jet systems, purpose-built pot washing machines for high-volume back-of-house operations, and flight-type conveyor systems for canteen-scale tray washing. For hotel operations with large banqueting programmes, we design complete dishwash areas as part of the kitchen planning process, incorporating pre-rinse spray arms, sorting tables, soiled ware trolleys, and clean ware storage racking in a logical, hygienic flow that minimises handling and cross-contamination risk. Space-planning drawings are provided for all dishwash area designs.
Our Process Title: Calculating the Right Dishwasher Capacity for Your Kitchen
Our Process Description: Steelcraft uses a structured capacity calculation to specify warewashing equipment correctly. The process begins with peak cover count, menu type (the ratio of crockery, glassware, and cookware per cover), and the available service window between seatings. We calculate pieces per hour, translate this into baskets per hour, and select a machine whose rated capacity provides a comfortable working margin above peak demand — typically 20–30% headroom to allow for re-washing and variation. Hood-type machines are generally specified for operations processing between 40 and 100 covers per sitting; conveyor systems for larger volumes. We also review the physical dishwash area: soiled inlet, clean outlet, table heights, drainage falls, electrical supply, and ventilation — producing a complete dishwash area layout before equipment is ordered.
CTA 1 Description: Every dishwasher is specified against your actual peak cover count and menu profile — eliminating the guesswork that leads to under-powered machines and service bottlenecks.
CTA 2 Description: We supply Meiko, Hobart, Comenda, Electrolux, and DIHR — manufacturers with established spare parts availability and service coverage across the UAE.

Steelcraft supplies deck ovens, convection ovens, combi-ovens, rotary rack ovens, and pizza-specific ovens sourced from European and international manufacturers. Steelcraft supplies spiral mixers, fork mixers, and planetary mixers for dough — matched to batch size, dough type, and hydration level. Spiral mixers are the standard choice for bread and pizza dough, delivering efficient gluten development with minimal heat transfer. Fork mixers suit highly hydrated and artisan doughs requiring gentle handling. Planetary mixers cover versatile applications from dough to cream and batter. Proofing cabinets and retarder-proofers allow operators to control fermentation precisely — enabling overnight retarding workflows that improve flavour, reduce morning labour, and increase production flexibility. All equipment is available in a range of bowl capacities to match batch requirements.
Feature 3 Description: For café-bakeries, patisseries, and hotel pastry kitchens, Steelcraft supplies the specialist equipment that separates professional output from domestic results: dough sheeters and laminators for croissant and puff pastry; depositors and enrobers for filled and coated products; chocolate tempering machines; blast chillers sized for individual pastry batches; and bain maries and warming equipment for finished product holding. We also supply trolleys, racks, baking trays, and perforated baking sheets in standard and custom sizes — matching your oven rack dimensions precisely. Our pastry kitchen layouts account for the specific workflow of patisserie production, with dedicated chilled marble or stainless steel working surfaces and appropriate ventilation for heated processes.
Our Process Title: Matching Baking Equipment to Your Production Model
Our Process Description: Baking equipment specification at Steelcraft begins with a production model review: what products will you bake, in what quantities, over what daily production window, and with how many members of staff? From this we calculate oven deck area or rack capacity required, mixer bowl volume needed per batch, and proofing space required to support continuous production. We then map this against your available kitchen footprint and energy infrastructure. Where gas is unavailable or restricted, we specify electric alternatives and advise on supply capacity requirements. All baking equipment is sourced from manufacturers with UAE-compatible voltage and frequency ratings, and our commissioning team sets all programmable parameters — temperatures, steam injection, proofing humidity — before handover to your team.
CTA 1 Description: Every oven, mixer, and proofer is sized to your actual daily production requirements — not a generic recommendation that leaves you over- or under-equipped.
